The main takeaway from our work is that
the presence of folate in the yogurts was not due to the presence of folates produced by the LAB, but rather to the addition of synthetic folate by the manufacturer.
the Lactobacilli are not a monolithic genus and the ability to synthesize folates is not ubiquitous among them.
